"""Coverage forms for module_level_fastmcp (G0 review finding 3) besides the plain `FastMCP(...)`
call already in tests/fixtures/arch_scan_bad/: the attribute-call form, a `FastMCP` call inside a
decorator, inside a parameter default, and inside a lambda default. Python evaluates a
decorator, a default, and a lambda default when the enclosing `def`/`lambda` statement itself
runs -- at module level here -- never when the function is later called, so all four are
violations."""

from __future__ import annotations

import fastmcp
from fastmcp import FastMCP

server = fastmcp.FastMCP("attribute-form")


@FastMCP("decorator-form").tool
def registered() -> None:
    """A tool registered through a decorator that itself calls FastMCP(...)."""


def create_server(mcp: FastMCP = FastMCP("default-form")) -> FastMCP:
    """Compliant part of this case: the function BODY makes no module-level call. The VIOLATION
    is the parameter default above, evaluated when this `def` statement runs."""
    return mcp


with_lambda_default = lambda mcp=FastMCP("lambda-default-form"): mcp  # noqa: E731
